from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792486017/attempts/44ff304bb01845389149adac5e6f0a25/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-d2c5a784.py'
source='''def transform(grid):\n    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 8]\n    if not cells:\n        return []\n    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)\n    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)\n    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)\n    c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)\n    shape = [[grid[r][c] if grid[r][c] == 8 else 0 for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]\n    copies = sum(value == 4 for row in grid for value in row)\n    return [row * copies for row in shape]\n'''
program_path.write_text(source)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_d2c5a784', program_path)
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(module)
